_comment: z-layer scale ratchet (CD-05), COMPLETE. Every fixed/portaled overlay rides the --z-* scale in design/tokens.css via z-[var(--z-*)]; no app source carries a bespoke numeric z-[N]. zLayerScale.test.ts keeps it that way: a numeric z-[N] in ANY file turns CI red (the files list is empty, so every file is a clean file), and the count ceiling is 0. The scanner's anti-rot guard is a synthetic regex self-test, since there are no live offenders left for it to find.
